primitives.name: Triage Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Filtering design: low-filter = single condition (topic score > 7); high-filter = topic > 7 AND related-topic scores = 1 (e.g., sports-injury high-filter requires medicine/health > 7, cannabis = 1, opioids = 1) — the Boolean conjunction is meant to suppress the SLM's false-positive tendency.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'topic identifier (dimensionless)', 's_T': 'SLM score for topic T ∈ [1, 10] (dimensionless)', 'F_L': 'low-filter condition (boolean)', 'F_H': 'high-filter condition (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: SLM scores are interval-meaningful; cross-topic conditions act as independent suppressors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When s_T ≤ 7 or any related-topic score ≠ 1, filter rejects text.

layer2.mapping: The Boolean filter mimics GSI’s probabilistic rejection sampling where each topic score contributes to a composite likelihood of injury-relatedness.
layer2.telemetry: Inter-rater reliability (ICC, κ) and Spearman correlation between SLM and human ratings.

reasoning_traces.think:
The triage protocol employs a zero-shot phi-3-mini model to assign 1–10 scores per topic to massive volumes of news text. These scores are filtered via Boolean logic: low-filter accepts any topic score > 7, while high-filter requires multiple topic scores to exceed 7 and related topics to be scored at 1. This dual-layer filtering reduces false positives by leveraging cross-topic dependencies. The scoring mechanism assumes interval-meaningful scales and that SLM outputs align with human judgments. Reliability is measured through Spearman correlation, Fleiss’s κ, and ICC, ensuring consistency across raters and models. The system operates under the assumption that a 1–10 scale is valid for both humans and SLMs, and that Boolean conjunctions effectively suppress false positives. Failure modes include misalignment between SLM and human judgment, or breakdown when cross-topic signals are not independent. The protocol supports GSE’s ingestion pipeline by enabling scalable, cost-effective triage before expensive extraction steps.
